description: Opens a remote-control session and returns the link of the TokenizedBlock control panel: a visual dashboard (the block in the centre; Market, Trade, Brain and Chat tabs) for the user to open in their browser with their wallet. Give the link to the user. Then send commands with tblock_command and read what happened with tblock_panel_state. Commands are proposals: the block’s brain accepts or refuses each task, and only the user’s wallet signs.

block.description: Optional: the block to show first.

name: tblock_panel_open
title: Open the block control panel
